snippet.title: Dream Voyage Trailer
snippet.description:
Make sure to wishlist the game on Steam! Link below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4101940/Dream_Voyage

Well, this for sure has been an experience!

I started this project around May of this current year, and I have non-stop worked on it with some few breaks in between to achieve what you see right now. I'm still far from what I have in mind with it, and since this is my first videogame ever, I've been learning a lot while not putting too much pressure on me, which doesn't mean I'm not trying to deliver the best artistic experience I can create through something that I've loved my entire life, a videogame.

Hopefully you will enjoy this emotional narrative, which is meant to give the player something in return once you complete the game. Something you can carry with you for the rest of your life, something that may help you in one dark day.

I will appreciate every feedback you can give me. I'll make sure to make this an experience worth the cost! 
Until we meet again! 
.- KAT / Fire Cat

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Dream Voyage is an Indie Story rich Walking simulator focused on the exploration of introspective surreal levels in the dream world of a 10 years old blind child who's looking for the memories of their deceased mother. Dream Voyage's hudless experience will immerse you in this emotive searching.

Follow the introspective dream adventure of a 10-year-old blind child, who five years ago completely lost not only their sight but also the warmth of their beloved mother.

As the years went by, a feeling of emptiness embraced the child after noticing something very important was missing. No matter how hard they tried, they couldn't remember their mother's face at all.
Navigate surreal dreamscapes while exploring fragments of past memories, following the red flowery path that leads to her forgotten features.

Each dream reveals more than just distant echoes of their mother’s voice, more than long gone memories, they unveil how meaningful spending time with their mother was to built who they are at present.

Keep going deeper into the subconscious dream world. But watch out, 
you may not like what you will find. 

#exploration  #indie  #liminalspace  #gaming #indiegame
